gate_decision: stage29 adds a read-only exact-root host/root/BPF/netns preflight helper and product gate; it records prerequisites for a later live candidate but never starts the candidate, attaches eBPF, creates netns, or mutates default/product paths
name: stage29-exact-host-root-bpf-netns-preflight-gate

preflight_rows.area: exact isolated root and state paths
preflight_rows.boundary: path checks do not create files or grant live candidate permission
preflight_rows.evidence: runtime stage29-host-preflight requires an absolute /tmp child root and keeps config, pid, progress, log, run, traffic, sockets, assets, and cache paths under that root
preflight_rows.next_action: reuse the exact root for Stage 30 preflight records and fail before any mutation if a path escapes the root

preflight_rows.boundary: default mode does not read volatile host state and therefore cannot admit a live candidate
preflight_rows.evidence: without --probe-host the helper emits deterministic path checks and planned host checks for golden fixture validation
preflight_rows.next_action: use default mode for stable fixture tests and --probe-host for local host records

preflight_rows.boundary: the probe is read-only and still reports live_candidate_run_allowed=false
preflight_rows.evidence: --probe-host reads effective uid, bpffs mount, netns parent, memlock, kernel release, production pid/progress, dae processes, tproxy port, interface names, and netns name conflicts
preflight_rows.next_action: record --probe-host output in the local plan before any later root-gated attach or traffic smoke

preflight_rows.boundary: generated config validity is not a substitute for validating the actual candidate config file
preflight_rows.evidence: --require-existing-config validates the exact root config file before a live candidate can be considered
preflight_rows.next_action: generate the exact root with stage26-candidate-plan --write and rerun Stage 29 with --require-existing-config

preflight_rows.boundary: a clear host probe is only a prerequisite; Stage 29 still does not start a daemon
preflight_rows.evidence: probe checks /var/run/dae.pid, /var/run/dae.progress, existing dae processes, and tproxy TCP/UDP port occupancy
preflight_rows.next_action: abort later live candidate execution if any production conflict appears

preflight_rows.boundary: Stage 29 does not prove attach, cleanup, map reuse, DNS cache survival, or active traffic
preflight_rows.evidence: production_safety records no_interface_mutation, no_netns_mutation, no_ebpf_attach, no_var_run_mutation, no_systemd_mutation, and no_release_label_mutation
preflight_rows.next_action: Stage 30 may build a root-gated attach/cleanup smoke only after this preflight record exists

preflight_rows.boundary: Stage 29 host preflight cannot replace active datapath, outbound, benchmark, or clean product-chain evidence
preflight_rows.next_action: keep Go default and product defaults until the full Stage 28 admission order passes
